name: dougs-ai-tools
description: Small, independent tools for Claude Code and similar coding agents.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Write one Markdown file at the end of a coding session so a fresh session can continue the work.

plugins.name: pickup
plugins.description: Experimental. Resume from a handoff without pasting its path: finds the handoff for the current checkout and shows which one it chose, why, and what else it could have chosen, before loading it. Requires the handoff skill.

plugins.name: context-nudge
plugins.description: Tell the user and the model how full the context window is: silent below 40 percent, one notice on entry to each band above it, and a notice on every prompt from 90. Needs jq and a one-line status-line addition.
